messages:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: Pager triggered: metering-emitter-heartbeat delay > 600s, token-count ingestion delayed. Impact: delayed usage reports and transient overage flags for a subset of customers. Link: https://ops.redwood/incident/1751112222
jen (oncall): I'm oncall — ack. Starting live triage. pinging billing-eng and infra for help.
mike (sre): saw a big consumer lag on the metering consumer group ~ 00:05 UTC. grabbing logs and consumer metrics now.
thuy (billing-eng): looking at reporting pipeline — aggregator consumer offsets stalled, commit errors around 20:57. sample log: 
```
[2026-03-18T20:57:22Z] WARN consumer-group metering-agg partition=12 lag=12000 msgs
java.lang.OffsetOutOfRangeException: Requested offset 145678 > end offset 145000
```
omar (support-lead): FYI — 3 customers already got automated overage alerts. I'm pausing alert notifications for billing to avoid churn.
jen (oncall): ok pausing notifications is good. I'm going to try to force a graceful reconnect for emitter: `kubectl rollout restart deployment/metering-emitter -n prod-metrics`
luca (infra): hold on oncall — restart will cause brief producer spike. prefer scaling the consumer pool first so we can drain backlog. scaling metering-agg consumers from 3 -> 6.
mike (sre): scaling done — replicas=6. consumer lag dropping 12k -> 2.3k in last 90s.
thuy (billing-eng): kicked off a targeted backfill for the affected 10m window (job bf-1751112222) at low priority to avoid cascading load. Tracking job at https://jobs.redwood/bf-1751112222
omar (support-lead): sent a short customer note: "We're investigating delayed usage reports; you may see temporary alerts. We're on it and will update." Templates used, no escalations yet. :white_check_mark:
jen (oncall): monitoring dashboards show token ingest rate normalizing and p90 latency coming down. Keeping pager open 30m to validate.
incident-bot: status update -> acknowledged by jen (oncall). Incident timer: 00:14:36.
mike (sre): found two GC pauses on the emitter during the burst causing producer stall; combined with transient Kafka leader movement led to offset errors. Filed INC-852 for root cause tracking.
thuy (billing-eng): checksum job queued to compare pre/post backfill counts. Early estimate: no invoice-level impact but watch duplicate detection.
j en (oncall): (typo corrected) jen: moving to monitoring state. Action items: mike -> tune emitter GC and add heap guards; thuy -> run checksum and verify dedupe; luca -> adjust autoscale policy for metering-agg.
omar (support-lead): I'll hold customer comms and send a follow-up after 60m if stable.
jen (oncall): closing pager for now — will reopen if lag resurfaces. Will file postmortem and include mitigation checklist. Thanks all. :thumbsup:
